title: three kind lines
subtitle: a short practice for when it hurts

steps.text: when something hurts, there's a short practice with three parts.
one: this is hard. you name it, instead of pushing past it.
two: other people feel this too. you're not the only one.
three: what do i need right now? something small and real.
want to take a breath before you try it?

options.label: skip it
options.reply: of course. let's go straight to it.

steps.prompt: now the three lines, with your own ending:
steps.template: this is hard. other people feel this too. what i need right now is {x}
ideas: a glass of water and an early night.
to talk to someone who gets it.
to be gentle with myself today.

steps.text: these three parts come from self-compassion research: noticing it's hard, remembering you're not alone, and offering yourself some kindness.
this is hard. other people feel this too. what do i need right now?
save the three lines somewhere you'll see them, like your phone's lock screen.
